'''ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz Ibn Futūḥ ibn Ibrahīm ibn Abū Bakr''' ({{langx|ar|علي بن محمد بن عبد العزيز بن فتوح بن ابراهيم بن أبي بكر}}; 1312–1359/62 CE)<ref>{{Cite book |last=al-Ṣafādī |first=Ṣalāḥ al-Dīn Khalīl b. Aybak |title=Aʿyan al-ʿaṣr wa aʿwān al-naṣr |year=1998 |editor-last=Abū Zayd |editor-first=ʿAlī |volume=3 |location=Damascus |pages=521–528 |language=Arabic}}</ref>''',''' known as '''Ibn Durayhim al-Mawsilī''' ({{langx|ar|ابن الدريهم الموصلي}}) was an [[Arab]] [[writer]], [[mathematician]], [[cryptologist]] and [[scribe]].<ref name=":0" /> 

== Cryptology ==
Ibn al-Durayhim gave detailed descriptions of eight cipher systems that discussed [[substitution ciphers]], leading to the earliest suggestion of a "[[Cryptographic tableau|tableau]]" of the kind that two centuries later became known as the "[[Tabula recta|Vigenère table]]".<ref name=":0">{{cite book|last=Leeuw|first=ed. by Karl de|title=The History of Information Security: A Comprehensive Handbook|url=https://archive.org/details/historyinformati00leeu|url-access=limited|year=2007|page=[https://archive.org/details/historyinformati00leeu/page/n269 279]|publisher=Elsevier|isbn=978-0444516084|edition=1.|author2=Bergstra, Jan}}</ref>

His book entitled ''Clear Chapters Goals and Solving Ciphers'' (مقاصد الفصول المترجمة عن حل الترجمة) was recently discovered, but has yet to be published. It includes the use of the statistical techniques pioneered by [[Al-Kindi]] and [[Ibn 'Adlan]].<ref name="LB">{{cite journal|last=Broemeling|first=Lyle D.|title=An Account of Early Statistical Inference in Arab Cryptology|journal=The American Statistician|date=1 November 2011|volume=65|issue=4|pages=255–257|doi=10.1198/tas.2011.10191|s2cid=123537702}}</ref>

== ''The Book on the Usefulness of Animals'' ==
In the year 1355 CE, Ibn al-Durayhim compiled the ''Book on the Usefulness of Animals'' ({{langx|ar|كتاب منافع الحيوان}}).<ref name=":0" /> The work draws largely on the work of [[Ibn Bakhtīshūʿ]] and [[Aristotle]]. The manuscript is now housed in the [[Escorial Library]] (Ar.898).<ref name=":1">{{Cite journal |last=Contadini |first=Anna |date=1989 |title=The Kitāb [[Manāfiʿ al-Ḥayawān]] in the Escorial Library |journal=Islamic Art |volume=3 |pages=33–57}}</ref> The text contains 91 illustrations of various animals.<ref name=":1" />
